timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So our company wants to move to the cloud. Where do we even start?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Microsoft has the Cloud Adoption Framework. Seven steps from strategy to operations.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Seven steps? Can't we just lift and shift everything?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: That's what companies that end up with a $200K monthly bill thought too.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Fair point. What's the first step?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Strategy. Define WHY you're going to cloud. Cost? Agility? Scalability?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Plan what to migrate, Ready your landing zones, then Adopt by migrating workloads.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What are landing zones? Some kind of cloud infrastructure?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: They're pre-configured environments with governance and security built in.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Govern to set guardrails, Manage for operations, and Organize your teams.
